requirements.evidence: Research/Projects/BinaryTreeReduction/Reduction.lean:11-13 uses model.add at each internal node. requirements.requirement: Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.
requirements.evidence: Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Gamma.lean:8-9 defines gamma k u = k*u/(1-k*u); lines 33-54 prove its one-error recurrence. Research/Submission.lean:63-73 bounds the composed error u + gamma depth u * (1 + u) by gamma (depth + 1) u using that recurrence and ring algebra. Line 74 yields the requested bound.
